question: List the title and price of all Sci-Fi books, ordered by price from highest to lowest.
reference_sql: SELECT title, price FROM books WHERE genre = 'Sci-Fi' ORDER BY price DESC;

question: What is the total stock of all books published after 2020?
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(stock) FROM books WHERE published_year > 2020;

question: List the names of all authors from Nigeria.
reference_sql: SELECT name FROM authors WHERE country = 'Nigeria';

question: For each genre, what is the average book price, rounded to 2 decimal places? Order by genre name.
reference_sql: SELECT genre, ROUND(AVG(price), 2) AS avg_price FROM books GROUP BY genre ORDER BY genre;

question: Which customers have placed more than 2 orders? List their name and order count.
reference_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id HAVING COUNT(o.id) > 2;

question: What is the total revenue (quantity times unit price) from shipped orders only, rounded to 2 decimals?
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'shipped';

question: List the top 3 books by total quantity sold across all orders, from most to least.
reference_sql: SELECT b.title, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_qty FROM order_items oi JOIN books b ON b.id = oi.book_id GROUP BY b.id ORDER BY total_qty DESC LIMIT 3;

question: List the distinct names of customers who have at least one cancelled order.
reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.status = 'cancelled';

question: What is the title and author name of the single most expensive book?
reference_sql: SELECT b.title, a.name FROM books b JOIN authors a ON a.id = b.author_id ORDER BY b.price DESC LIMIT 1;

question: List each author's name and how many books they've written, only for authors with more than 1 book, ordered by book count descending then name ascending.
reference_sql: SELECT a.name, COUNT(b.id) AS book_count FROM authors a JOIN books b ON b.author_id = a.id GROUP BY a.id HAVING COUNT(b.id) > 1 ORDER BY book_count DESC, a.name ASC;
